models_evaluated: Hybrid LLM-guided modular RL framework (SARSA with linear function approximation; LLM Planner/Evaluator/Supervisor agents)
unlisted_practices: Hybrid LLM-supervised modular reinforcement learning to automate radiotherapy treatment plan refinement
Comparison of hybrid RL+LLM planning versus LLM-only and knowledge-based planning on clinical goal achievement and efficiency

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a hybrid modular reinforcement learning and LLM multi-agent framework for lung radiotherapy treatment planning on retrospective cases. It focuses on the model architecture rather than evaluating organizational deployment safeguards or practices.
